analysis:
Integration pass over units 44-83. No finding is supported by the supplied evidence.

Most of the PR is documentation (docs/architecture/inference.md, docs/provider/two-mac-cluster.md, docs/operations/provider-release.md, CHANGELOG.md) plus a version bump to 0.10.13 (ProviderCore.swift). The code changes are:
(1) A cluster stop-counter. ClusterSetupRecord.stopsAsked is a new optional Int. ClusterControlRequest.stopsBefore and ClusterControlReply.stopsAsked are new optional fields. The new operations hooks stopsAsked and serveUnlessStopped default to nil/no-op. OnboardingLive.localServe(unlessStoppedSince:), localRegister and followerStatus use them. ClusterOnboardingFollowedStop and ClusterOnboardingStopped.asked(since:now:) replace the 20-second "Stopped" heuristic. All of it sits on the owner-only, pairing-keyed cable control channel between the owner's two Macs. A peer already controls stop and serve there, so a forged or inflated count can at most end a wait or suppress a serve, which is a limited availability effect. A nil count fails safe (no stop is inferred). This does not touch TB-002, TB-011, A-001 or T-041.
(2) The Gemma 4 loop-exit-thinking continuation (EngineV2Bridge+Events/LoopGuard, LoopExitThinkingContinuation). The remaining budget is bounded (cap 8,192 tokens, skipped below 256, 5-second slot-release wait). The cancel path was checked. Chunks go through the existing downstream encryption (T-008). Logs and telemetry carry only a fixed ends_thought bool, no prompt text. The continuation reuses the same cache scope and sampling, so T-041 account scoping is not widened as documented.
(3) MiMoV26NativeLoadTransaction: a test-only hook invoked outside the lock, with no behavior change.

Unverified contracts for the next pass:
(a) OnboardingLive.stop/recordStop and the lock semantics of serveUnlessStopped could not be checked against the TOCTOU claim, because they are partly outside the supplied heads.
(b) Whether the link control channel authenticates every sender before stopsBefore is honored.
(c) Whether the continuation's submit passes the original cacheSalt and billing correctly (the code is in EngineV2Bridge, not in the supplied units).
(d) The ClusterOnboardingFlow.swift head hunks near 2901-3535 were only partly visible.
No threat-model update is needed from the visible changes.
